claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the same actor, action, object, time and place, and substitutes an obligation operator (must, is required to, is mandatory, applies by default) for the permissive operator.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence states a permissive or optional status for a specified actor-action pair (permitted, may, optional, eligible, available on request), and no evidence item states an obligation, requirement, penalty, or default for that same actor-action pair.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the claim also alters population scope, quantity, time, actor or outcome; if any evidence item states a requirement or a consequence of non-performance; or if the substituted element is an evaluative, causal or quantitative term rather than a deontic operator.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (scoped measurement asserted across all operating conditions) and H1T011 (availability conflated with demonstrated effectiveness). H1T019 substitutes a universal quantifier over conditions and leaves predicate type unchanged; H2T001 leaves quantification unchanged and substitutes the deontic operator. H1T011 replaces an availability predicate with an efficacy predicate about outcomes; H2T001 introduces no outcome or efficacy predicate.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) exactly one evidence sentence supports the permissive proposition; (2) every actor, action, object, time and place token in the claim matches that sentence; (3) the deontic operator is the only non-matching element; (4) no evidence item states an obligation, penalty or default for that pair.

claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the value, quantity, unit, entity and time exactly and attributes it to a different named method or instrument appearing in the EvidencePack.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. Two or more distinct measurement methods, instruments, assays, tools or data-collection modes are named in the EvidencePack, and a reported value is explicitly attributed to exactly one of them.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the value is altered, rounded or rescaled; if no second method is named in evidence; if evidence states the methods are interchangeable or calibrated to each other; or if the claim asserts a comparison, superiority or causal relation between methods.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (condition-scoped measurement generalised to all conditions) and H1T016 (supported extraction of a metric for a specific condition). H1T019 widens scope to a universal set; H2T002 performs a lateral swap between two named instruments with no widening. H1T016 is a faithful extraction that preserves the evidence-stated binding; H2T002 breaks exactly that binding.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) at least two measurement methods are named in evidence; (2) the value is explicitly bound to one of them by an evidence sentence; (3) the claim's numeral, unit, entity and time match that sentence; (4) the method token is the only substituted element.

claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the act, object, time and place and attributes it to a different actor named in the EvidencePack.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. The EvidencePack names at least two distinct actors, organisations, authors or units, and one evidence sentence attributes a specific act (performed, issued, approved, authored, operated, funded) to one of them.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the claim alters the act, object, date or outcome; if evidence states the actors acted jointly or one acted on behalf of the other; or if the claim asserts responsibility for an outcome rather than performance of the stated act (see H2T089).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T003 (arbitrary selection of one source's value in a conflict) and H1T014 (disregarding a dissenting classifier). H1T003 requires an explicit value conflict and resolves it; H2T003 requires no conflict at all and swaps an attribution that evidence states unambiguously. H1T014 discards a recorded dissent to assert a criterion outcome; H2T003 asserts no criterion outcome.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) two or more actors are named in evidence; (2) the act is explicitly attributed to one of them; (3) all non-actor components of the claim match the attributing sentence; (4) the actor token is the only substituted element.

claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the value and the date and asserts that the underlying event occurred, was achieved or took effect on the reporting date.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence dates or timestamps when a value, status or result was reported, recorded, logged, filed or published, and no evidence item dates when the underlying state came about.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the claim asserts that the date caused, explains or produced the value; if evidence states the record was contemporaneous with the event; or if the claim also changes the value or entity.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T021 (asserting the observation date caused the measured value) and H1T029 (supported statement of an end date and absence of later follow-up). H1T021 is a causal attribution to a date; H2T004 makes no causal assertion and only substitutes the event predicate. H1T029 preserves the reporting/occurrence distinction; H2T004 collapses it.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence sentence uses a reporting, recording, filing or publication predicate; (2) the claim uses an occurrence, achievement or effectivity predicate; (3) value, entity and date tokens are otherwise identical; (4) no evidence item independently dates the occurrence.

claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the identical numeral, variable, unit and population and labels it as a different named summary statistic.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence reports a numeral for an explicitly named summary statistic of a distribution (for example median, mode, maximum, mean, percentile) for a defined variable and population.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the numeral changes; if the claim changes the population or base (assign a U2 template instead); if evidence states the distribution is symmetric or that the statistics are equal; or if the claim performs an arithmetic operation on group values (see H2T017).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T025 (completion file count presented as a 100% completion rate) and H1T030 (subset numerator over a total-registered denominator). Both H1 entries change the base or convert a count into a rate; H2T005 changes neither numeral nor base and substitutes only the distributional label.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence sentence names the statistic explicitly; (2) the claim names a different statistic; (3) the numeral, unit, variable and population tokens are identical; (4) no evidence item states the two statistics coincide for this distribution.

claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the value and threshold and substitutes a different relational operator (exactly equals, exceeded, fell short of, met precisely) that the bound does not determine.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence relates a measured value to a stated threshold, target or limit using an explicit inequality or bound (at least, no more than, below, within, up to).
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the substituted relation is entailed by the stated bound; if the claim changes the threshold or the measured quantity; or if the claim adds an evaluative adequacy judgement about meeting the threshold (see H2T095).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T013 (declaring conclusive superiority from raw values without equivalence adjustment) and H1T018 (subset presented as all sampled records). H1T013 is a comparative ranking claim across arms; H2T006 compares one value to one stated threshold and asserts no superiority. H1T018 alters how many units satisfy a criterion; H2T006 alters the relational operator for a single stated value.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence sentence contains an explicit bound or inequality; (2) the claim asserts a relation not entailed by that bound; (3) value, threshold, unit and entity tokens are otherwise identical; (4) no other evidence item fixes the exact relation.

claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the numeral, metric, unit and entity and asserts it as the observed, achieved or actual result.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence states a planned, targeted, specified, budgeted or protocol value for a named metric, and no evidence item reports a realised measurement of that metric.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if any evidence item reports the realised value; if the claim changes the numeral; if the claim asserts completion of an activity rather than a metric value; or if the evidence value is an interim measurement rather than a plan (see H2T042).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T022 (all completers presented as satisfied where satisfaction was never reported) and H1T017 (finite observed performance extended into indefinite persistence). H1T022 fabricates an unmeasured attribute for an observed group; H2T007 reuses an evidence-stated numeral and changes only its epistemic status from planned to realised. H1T017 extends a realised measurement in time; H2T007 involves no realised measurement and no temporal extension.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence sentence is explicitly prospective or normative (plan, target, specification, protocol, budget, design value); (2) the claim is explicitly retrospective or factual; (3) numeral, unit, metric and entity match; (4) no evidence item reports the realised value of that metric.

claim_transformation: The claim reproduces the identical numeral and asserts it as the count of the other unit type.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence reports a count whose counted unit is explicitly named (for example episodes, visits, records, transactions, sessions, submissions), and the EvidencePack also names a different unit type (for example distinct individuals, organisations, devices) without reporting its count.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states each unit of one type corresponds to exactly one of the other; if the claim forms a rate or proportion (assign a U2 template); or if the claim attributes an attribute such as satisfaction or completion to the units.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T012 (respondent count conflated with the number of enrollees who are satisfied) and H1T025 (completion file count presented as a completion rate). H1T012 both swaps the counted population and imports an unmeasured satisfaction attribute; H2T008 imports no attribute and forms no rate. H1T025 converts a count into a percentage; H2T008 keeps the numeral as a count.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence sentence names the counted unit explicitly; (2) the claim names a different unit type; (3) the numeral is unchanged; (4) no evidence item states a one-to-one correspondence between the two unit types.

claim_transformation: The claim restates the identical proposition as an established fact of the world, deleting the attribution or provenance marker.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence carries an explicit attribution or provenance marker for a factual statement (self-reported, vendor-reported, according to X, per applicant submission, unverified), and no evidence item independently corroborates the statement.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if another evidence item independently corroborates the statement; if the claim asserts the statement was audited, certified or verified (see H2T072); or if the claim converts a reported belief into a causal assertion (see H2T033).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T027 (asserting peer review and high quality despite a missing status field) and H1T020 (asserting high citation status from a record with missing citation fields). Both H1 entries fabricate a positive attribute from an absent field; H2T009 adds no new attribute and removes an attribution marker that is explicitly present.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the attribution marker is explicit in the evidence sentence; (2) the claim's proposition content matches that sentence in entity, value and scope; (3) the removed attribution is the only altered element; (4) no other evidence item verifies the statement.

claim_transformation: The claim states the same relation type with the two arguments exchanged.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence states an asymmetric ordered relation between two named items (greater than, precedes, is a subset of, reports to, depends on, is derived from).
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the relation is symmetric; if the claim changes the relation type or magnitude; if the claim asserts causation between the items (assign a U3 template); or if evidence elsewhere states the reverse relation for a different time or condition.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T007 (supported comparison of two conditions and their metric values) and H1T023 (supported identification of an unresolved numerical conflict). H1T007 preserves the evidence-stated ordering; H2T010 inverts exactly that ordering. H1T023 requires an explicit conflict; H2T010 requires a single unambiguous relation.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence relation is asymmetric and explicitly stated; (2) both arguments are named in that sentence; (3) the claim's relation type, magnitude and qualifiers are otherwise identical; (4) argument order is the only substituted element.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the identical outcome under a different named condition drawn from the EvidencePack, leaving the outcome, value and entity unchanged.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence states an outcome, value or status that holds under an explicitly named condition, and the EvidencePack separately names at least one other condition, arm, tier, plan or configuration for which that outcome is not reported.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the claim asserts the outcome across all, any or unspecified conditions (that is a universal widening and is forbidden H1 territory); if the substituted condition is not named in evidence; or if the claim asserts the condition caused the outcome.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (measurement scoped to one operating condition asserted across all operating conditions) and H1T026 (conditional group result presented as the overall cohort result). Both H1 entries widen to a universal or superset population; H2T011 performs a lateral swap to one other explicitly named condition and asserts nothing about the union or the whole.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the outcome is explicitly conditioned in evidence; (2) the substituted condition is named somewhere in the EvidencePack; (3) the claim asserts the outcome for that named condition only, without generalising to all conditions; (4) no evidence item reports the outcome under the substituted condition.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the property is absent, did not exist or did not occur, converting non-detection into established absence.
evidence_condition: U1 frame: the EvidencePack explicitly supports a neighbouring proposition P_e about the same entity and the same factual dimension; the claim asserts P_c, which differs from P_e by exactly one substituted material element and is not entailed by any evidence item. One evidence sentence states that a search, test, screen, review or monitoring activity did not detect, observe or record a specified property, and the EvidencePack states no sensitivity, coverage or completeness guarantee for that activity.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the activity is exhaustive or fully sensitive; if the evidence sentence itself states a positive negative fact (the property was confirmed absent); if the claim concerns the nullity of a causal effect (see H2T034); or if the claim reports only that the pack contains no information (see H2T083).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T022 (all completers presented as satisfied where satisfaction was not reported), H1T027 and H1T020 (positive attributes asserted from missing record fields). Each H1 entry converts missing information into a positive attribute; H2T012 converts an explicitly reported non-detection into a categorical negative existential, and requires a named detection activity rather than an absent field.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence sentence reports non-detection by a named activity; (2) the claim asserts categorical absence or non-occurrence; (3) entity, property and scope tokens are otherwise identical; (4) no evidence item states that the activity would have detected the property if present.

claim_transformation: The claim applies the rate from the first population to the size of the second and asserts the resulting product as a count of affected units.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states a rate, proportion or per-unit figure established in one explicitly named population or sample, and separately states a size, count or total for a different named population.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the rate applies to B or that A and B are the same population; if the claim merely restates the rate for A; or if the claim asserts that B's members are representative of A (see H2T097).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T001 (subgroup result applied to the entire population) and H1T030 (subset numerator over a total-registered denominator). H1T001 asserts the rate itself holds for a superset; H2T013 asserts no rate for B and instead manufactures a new absolute count by multiplying across two distinct populations. H1T030 computes a share using a wrong denominator from the same population; H2T013 crosses two separately defined populations.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the rate is explicitly bound to population A; (2) the size figure is explicitly bound to a different population B; (3) the claim states a count obtained by combining them; (4) no evidence item states that the rate applies to B.

claim_transformation: The claim sums the overlapping counts and asserts the total as a number of distinct units, or asserts the summed figure as a share of a stated population.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports two or more counts and explicitly indicates that their members can overlap (multiple selections permitted, records appearing in more than one source, repeat participation, categories described as non-exclusive).
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the categories are mutually exclusive; if a deduplicated total is reported and restated faithfully; or if the claim derives a joint count from separately stated marginals (see H2T020).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T028 (supported reporting of total intake and completion counts) and H1T025 (completion file count presented as a completion rate). H1T028 restates counts that evidence supplies; H2T014 creates a total that no evidence item supplies by adding sets evidence marks as overlapping. H1T025 converts one count into a rate without a second count.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) evidence explicitly indicates possible overlap or non-exclusivity; (2) the claim reports an additive total or a share derived from it; (3) the claim presents the total as unduplicated; (4) no evidence item reports a deduplicated count.

claim_transformation: The claim restates the same difference in the other scale, presenting a converted magnitude that the evidence does not determine.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a difference between two figures expressed explicitly in one scale (percentage points, absolute units, index points, or a relative percentage change), and does not state the base value required to convert between scales.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the base value is stated anywhere in evidence and the conversion is arithmetically correct; if the claim preserves the evidence scale; or if the claim converts between count and rate using a stated denominator.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T025 (completion file count presented as a 100% completion rate) and H1T013 (conclusive superiority from raw values without equivalence adjustment). H1T025 converts a raw count into a rate against an implied full denominator; H2T015 converts between two difference scales for a quantity whose base is absent, and asserts no completion or superiority.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence scale is explicit; (2) the claim uses the other scale; (3) the numeral is carried over or arithmetically transformed without the required base; (4) the base needed for the conversion is absent from the EvidencePack.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the cumulative quantity as the value for the single named period, or asserts a single-period quantity as the cumulative total.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a quantity that is explicitly marked as cumulative, to-date, lifetime or year-to-date, and separately identifies a shorter reporting period (month, quarter, cycle, cohort window).
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence supplies both the cumulative and the period figure and the claim uses the correct one; if the claim projects the figure into a future window (see H2T091); or if the claim asserts a value for a sub-period of a reported aggregate (see H2T045).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T028 (supported reporting of total intake and completion counts) and H1T017 (finite observed performance extended into indefinite persistence). H1T028 restates a total within its stated window; H2T016 re-binds a numeral between accounting windows that both exist in evidence. H1T017 extends beyond the observed window; H2T016 stays inside it.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the accumulation status of the evidence figure is explicit; (2) the claim binds that numeral to a differently scoped accounting window; (3) the numeral is unchanged; (4) no evidence item supplies the figure for the window used in the claim.

claim_transformation: The claim computes or asserts an unweighted average of the group-level values as the overall population value.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a metric separately for two or more groups, sites, cohorts or strata and also states that those groups differ in size, volume or weight.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence reports the pooled figure; if evidence states the groups are of equal size; if the claim asserts one group's value for the whole population (forbidden H1 territory); or if the claim only relabels a statistic without computing across groups (see H2T005).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T001 (subgroup result applied to the entire population) and H1T026 (conditional group result presented as the overall cohort result). Both H1 entries transfer one group's value to a superset; H2T017 uses all reported groups and manufactures a new aggregate whose defect is the omission of stated weights.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) group-level values are explicitly reported; (2) evidence explicitly states unequal group sizes or volumes; (3) the claim asserts a single overall figure equal to the unweighted mean of group values; (4) no evidence item reports the pooled or weighted overall figure.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts an exact count, total or base value derived by inverting the rounded figure, presenting a precision the evidence does not determine.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states a percentage, share or ratio that is explicitly rounded, approximate or bounded (about, approximately, roughly, to the nearest whole percent), and states one further figure from which a count could be back-computed.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the exact value; if the claim preserves the approximation marker and a consistent interval; or if the claim inverts a conditional share rather than reconstructing precision (see H2T023).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T025 (completion file count presented as a completion rate) and H1T030 (wrong denominator for a satisfaction percentage). Both H1 entries move from counts to a mis-based rate; H2T018 moves in the reverse arithmetic direction from an explicitly approximate rate to a falsely exact count, and its defining defect is manufactured precision rather than a substituted base population.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the rounding or approximation marker is explicit; (2) the claim states an exact integer or point value; (3) that value is obtained by inverting the approximate figure; (4) no evidence item states the exact value.

claim_transformation: The claim restates the same numeral as a share of persons, units or cases (a percentage of participants, a proportion of items), changing the kind of denominator rather than its size.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a frequency whose denominator is an explicitly named exposure quantity (per operating hour, per 1,000 units dispatched, per participant-year, per session, per shift).
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence supplies both forms; if evidence states the conversion factor and the claim applies it correctly; or if the claim changes the size of the same kind of denominator (assign H2T021 or another U2 template).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T030 (smaller respondent subset over a total-registered denominator) and H1T012 (respondents conflated with satisfied enrollees). Both H1 entries substitute one population count for another population count; H2T019 keeps population size out of the operation entirely and changes the denominator's dimensional kind from exposure to headcount.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the exposure denominator is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim's denominator is a count of units or persons; (3) the numeral is carried over without a stated conversion factor; (4) no evidence item supplies the per-unit share.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts a count or share of units possessing both attributes, or possessing at least one of them, derived from the separate marginals.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports two or more separate marginal shares or counts for distinct attributes over the same population and does not report their joint distribution or cross-tabulation.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence reports the cross-tabulation; if the claim asserts only a bound that the marginals entail (that is supported territory, see H2T074); or if the claim sums counts evidence marks as overlapping (see H2T014).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T018 (subset presented as all sampled records) and H1T028 (supported reporting of totals). H1T018 changes how many records satisfy one criterion; H2T020 combines two independently reported attribute distributions into a joint quantity that evidence never measures.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the marginals are explicitly reported for the same population; (2) no evidence item reports the joint or overlap figure; (3) the claim asserts an intersection or union quantity; (4) the asserted quantity is not entailed by the marginals as stated bounds.

claim_transformation: The claim states a proportion, rate or coverage figure whose numerator and denominator are drawn from different levels of that hierarchy.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports counts at two different levels of a stated hierarchy (for example sites and participants, orders and line items, classes and learners, cases and documents) and makes the level of each count explicit.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the conversion ratio between levels; if numerator and denominator are at the same level but the wrong subset is used (forbidden H1 territory); or if the claim reports both counts separately without forming a ratio.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T030 (subset numerator over total-registered denominator) and H1T025 (file count presented as a completion rate). Both H1 entries mis-scope a denominator within a single unit level; H2T021's defect is a mismatch in the unit of hierarchy itself, which no H1 entry performs.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) both counts are explicitly level-labelled in evidence; (2) the claim forms a single ratio across levels; (3) no evidence item supplies the same-level counterpart count; (4) no evidence item states a fixed units-per-parent conversion.

claim_transformation: The claim assigns those units to a substantive category of that field, or computes a share as if the field were complete, so that the missing units silently count as possessing or lacking the attribute.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack explicitly reports a number of records, responses or units with missing, unknown, not-recorded or pending values for a specified field.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence resolves the missing values; if the claim explicitly excludes them and states the reduced base; or if the claim asserts that no information exists in the pack (see H2T083).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T022 (all completers presented as satisfied where satisfaction was not reported) and H1T018 (subset presented as all sampled records). H1T022 fabricates an attribute where the field is entirely absent; H2T022 requires an explicitly quantified missing-value count and its defect is the arithmetic treatment of that quantified subset inside a denominator.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the missing-value count is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim's figure can only be obtained by treating missing units as a substantive category; (3) no evidence item resolves the missing values; (4) the claim does not disclose the missing units.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the numerically identical share in the inverted direction, swapping the conditioning set and the attribute set.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a conditional share in one explicit direction: the proportion of members of group B that have attribute A (or the proportion of A-cases that came from B).
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence supplies both base rates and the inversion is computed correctly; if the claim changes the numeral; or if the claim transfers a rate to a different population's size (see H2T013).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T030 (wrong denominator for a satisfaction percentage) and H1T026 (conditional group result presented as the overall cohort result). H1T026 widens a conditional result to the whole cohort; H2T023 does not widen at all but exchanges the conditioning set with the attribute set, which is a distinct arithmetic operation.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the conditioning direction is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim states the inverted conditional; (3) the numeral is unchanged; (4) the base rates needed to invert the conditional are not both present in evidence.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts a normalised per-capita, per-unit or density figure for that entity.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports an absolute total for a named entity and does not report the population, area, volume, time or unit count needed to normalise it, while naming at least one such unit qualitatively.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the normalising quantity is present anywhere in evidence; if the claim restates the absolute total; or if the claim applies a rate from another population (see H2T013).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T004 (dataset asserted to be a high-quality benchmark from its record count) and H1T025 (completion file count presented as a completion rate). H1T004 converts a count into an evaluative property; H2T024 converts a count into a quantitative normalised rate with no available base, asserting no quality judgement. H1T025 uses an implied complete denominator drawn from the same evidence; in H2T024 no denominator exists anywhere in the pack.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) only the absolute total is reported; (2) the normalising quantity is absent from every evidence item; (3) the claim states a per-unit or per-capita figure; (4) the claim's figure cannot be derived from the pack.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts a causal relation running from the variable that the evidence treats as the outcome to the variable the evidence treats as the exposure.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports an association, co-occurrence or sequence between two variables and states no design feature (randomisation, controlled manipulation, instrument, natural experiment) that fixes the direction of influence between them.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence establishes direction; if the claim asserts the evidence-ordered direction (assign another U3 template); or if the claim swaps the arguments of a non-causal relation (see H2T010).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T008 (correlation converted into a sole causal pathway) and H1T005 (pre/post change treated as causal). H1T008 preserves the evidence-implied direction and adds exclusivity; H1T005 requires a before/after intervention structure. H2T025 requires neither exclusivity nor an intervention and its defining operation is inversion of causal direction.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the association is explicitly reported; (2) the evidence contains no design element fixing direction; (3) the claim states a directional causal relation; (4) that direction is the reverse of the exposure-to-outcome ordering used in the evidence.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts a quantified counterfactual: what the outcome would have been, or how much was gained, avoided, saved or prevented, in the absence of the factor.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports an outcome measured in a single arm, group or period with no control group, comparison arm, baseline counterfactual or modelled expected value.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence supplies a comparator or expected value; if the claim is an unquantified causal attribution (assign another U3 template); or if the claim asserts that a safeguard prevented an unobserved event without a magnitude (see H2T030).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T008 (sole causal pathway from correlation) and H1T005 (pre/post change treated as causal). Both H1 entries attribute an observed change to a factor; H2T026 asserts the magnitude of an unobserved alternative world, which requires no observed change at all and no attribution of the observed value.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) evidence contains no comparator or expected-value estimate; (2) the claim states a counterfactual magnitude or an averted/gained quantity; (3) that magnitude is not reported by any evidence item; (4) the claim is quantified rather than a bare attribution.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that increasing or decreasing the factor yields a correspondingly larger or smaller effect, asserting a dose-response relation.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports an effect, result or performance level measured at exactly one dose, intensity, duration, frequency or coverage level, and reports no second level of that factor.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if two or more levels are reported; if the claim asserts performance at an untested level of a non-causal operating parameter (see H2T039); or if the claim asserts only that the factor had an effect at the tested level.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T005 (pre/post change treated as causal) and H1T017 (finite observation extended into indefinite persistence). H1T005 concerns whether a factor acted at all; H2T027 presupposes an effect and fabricates its functional form across unobserved levels. H1T017 extends along the time axis; H2T027 extends along an intensity axis and asserts a causal law rather than persistence.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) only one level of the factor is reported; (2) the claim asserts a monotone or proportional relation between factor level and effect size; (3) no evidence item reports a second level or a fitted dose-response relation.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the relation holds causally for individual members of those groups.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports an association measured between aggregate or group-level quantities (site averages, regional rates, cohort-level proportions) and reports no individual-level data linking the two attributes.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if individual-level data are reported; if the claim restates the group-level association without causal or individual-level content; or if the claim merely applies a group figure to a whole population (forbidden H1 territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T001 (subgroup result applied to the entire population) and H1T008 (sole causal pathway from correlation). H1T001 is a descriptive transfer between populations at the same level of analysis; H2T028 changes the level of analysis from aggregate to individual and adds causal content. H1T008 operates on an association already at the level claimed.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the reported association is explicitly at group level; (2) the claim's subject is an individual member or the individual-level relation; (3) the claim asserts causation or effect on individuals; (4) no evidence item reports individual-level linkage.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the same causal effect holds, or will hold, in the other named setting.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a causal or interventional result obtained in one explicitly named setting, population, market, jurisdiction or configuration, and names at least one other such setting without reporting the effect there.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if a replication or transportability statement exists in evidence; if the claim asserts a descriptive value rather than a causal effect in the other setting (see H2T048); or if the claim generalises to all settings universally (forbidden H1 territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (measurement scoped to one operating condition asserted across all operating conditions) and H1T005 (pre/post change treated as causal). H1T019 is a universal descriptive widening with no causal content; H2T029 transports an already-causal claim to one specifically named alternative setting. H1T005 concerns establishing causation in the observed setting, which H2T029 presupposes.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the effect is explicitly bound to the source setting; (2) the target setting is named in evidence; (3) the claim asserts a causal effect in the target setting; (4) no evidence item reports transport conditions, effect modifiers or a replication in the target setting.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the safeguard prevented, averted or protected against the adverse event.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states that a control, safeguard, review step or mitigation was in place during a period and separately states that no adverse event, failure or defect of a specified type was observed in that period, with no comparison period or unprotected arm reported.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if a baseline or comparison rate is reported; if the claim asserts only that no event occurred while the safeguard was in place; or if the claim asserts a safety property from a non-safety performance measurement (forbidden H1 territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T015 (safety established from a non-safety performance measurement) and H1T011 (availability conflated with effectiveness). H1T015 substitutes one measured property for another; H2T030 requires an explicitly reported non-event and asserts a causal preventive relation between two stated facts. H1T011 requires no outcome observation at all.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) both the safeguard and the non-occurrence are explicitly stated; (2) no unprotected comparison period, arm or baseline rate is reported; (3) the claim asserts preventive efficacy; (4) the claim states no counterfactual magnitude (otherwise assign H2T026).

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the earlier-moving series drives, leads to, or determines the later-moving series.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports two co-observed time series, trends or sequences and states their relative timing (one moved, peaked or changed before the other), with no intervention, randomisation or identification strategy reported.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence reports an intervention applied to one series (assign the pre/post family, which is forbidden H1 territory); if the claim asserts an internal mechanism (forbidden H1 territory); or if the claim asserts the reverse of the evidence-stated ordering (see H2T025).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T005 (pre/post change treated as causal), H1T021 (observation date asserted as the cause of a value) and H1T008 (sole pathway from correlation). H1T005 requires a single variable measured before and after an intervention; H2T031 requires two independently measured series and no intervention. H1T021 treats a date as a cause; H2T031 treats a co-observed series as the cause and uses ordering only as the inferential warrant.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) two measured series are reported; (2) their temporal ordering is explicit in evidence; (3) the claim asserts a driving or determining relation based on that ordering; (4) no evidence item reports a design or test establishing the relation.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the modelled relation or effect as an established real-world causal fact, deleting the modelling qualifier.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports results explicitly labelled as modelled, simulated, projected, estimated under assumptions, or produced by a scenario or forecast, and reports no empirical measurement of the same relation.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if empirical validation is reported; if the claim preserves the modelled status; or if the claim strips an attribution marker from a descriptive statement without causal content (see H2T009).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T005 (pre/post change treated as causal) and H1T006 (internal mechanism asserted without mechanistic measurement). Both H1 entries start from observed data and add unmeasured causal content; H2T032 starts from output that evidence explicitly marks as non-observational and converts its epistemic status, which no H1 entry does.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the modelling label is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim asserts a real-world causal effect or produced outcome; (3) the modelling qualifier is absent from the claim; (4) no evidence item reports an empirical validation of the model.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the factor did produce the outcome, converting a reported attitude or attribution into a causal fact.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports that participants, staff, clinicians, customers or experts stated, believed, perceived or rated that a factor helped, caused or improved something, and reports no measurement of the relation itself.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the relation is independently measured; if the claim restates the perception as a perception (supported territory); or if the claim converts a stated intention into a realised behaviour (see H2T065).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T006 (internal mechanism asserted without mechanistic measurement), H1T008 (sole pathway from correlation) and H1T011 (availability conflated with effectiveness). Each H1 entry derives causal content from objective records; H2T033 derives it from an explicitly subjective report and its defining operation is the removal of the attitude operator.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the evidence sentence is explicitly about what respondents said, believed or rated; (2) the claim asserts the causal relation as fact; (3) the attitude marker is absent from the claim; (4) no evidence item measures the relation independently.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the factor has no effect, makes no difference, or that the groups are equivalent.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a comparison or effect estimate that it explicitly marks as not statistically significant, inconclusive, underpowered, or based on a small number of events.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if an equivalence test with a margin is reported; if the claim restates the non-significant result with its qualifier (supported territory, see H2T080); or if the claim concerns the existence of a property rather than a causal effect (see H2T012).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T013 (conclusive superiority declared from raw values without equivalence adjustment) and H1T014 (dissent disregarded to assert a criterion was met). H1T013 asserts a difference; H2T034 asserts the absence of a causal effect from an explicitly inconclusive estimate, and requires an explicit non-significance or power marker in evidence, which H1T013 does not.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the inconclusiveness, non-significance or power limitation is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim asserts a null causal effect or equivalence; (3) no evidence item reports an equivalence or non-inferiority test with a stated margin; (4) the claim omits the stated limitation.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the final outcome improved, was achieved or was caused, on the basis of the intermediate measure's movement.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a change in an intermediate, surrogate, process or leading measure and separately identifies a distinct final or downstream outcome for which no change is reported.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the final outcome is measured and reported; if evidence states a validated surrogate relationship; if the claim substitutes one property for another without asserting change or causation (assign a U6 template); or if the claim confirms a diagnosis from an abnormal value (forbidden H1 territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T009 (underlying diagnosis confirmed from an abnormal value without diagnostic testing) and H1T015 (safety established from a non-safety measure). H1T009 infers a present latent state from a static value; H2T035 infers movement in or causation of a distinct downstream outcome from an observed change in another measure. H1T015 involves no change and no downstream outcome.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the intermediate and final measures are distinct and both named in evidence; (2) only the intermediate measure's change is reported; (3) the claim asserts movement in or causation of the final outcome; (4) no evidence item reports the linkage between them.

claim_transformation: The claim credits one named component of the bundle with the aggregate result.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states that an intervention, package or change was delivered as an explicitly multi-component bundle and reports the aggregate result without any component-level measurement or decomposition.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if component-level results are reported; if the claim attributes the result to an unmeasured internal mechanism rather than a delivered component (forbidden H1 territory); if the claim credits an actor rather than a component (see H2T089); or if the claim asserts that the credited component is the only possible cause of a correlation (forbidden H1 territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T008 (sole causal pathway asserted from correlation) and H1T006 (specific internal mechanism asserted without measurement). H1T008 starts from a correlation with no enumerated intervention structure and asserts exclusivity; H2T036 starts from an explicitly enumerated delivered bundle and performs a partitioning attribution among stated components. H1T006 posits an unobservable internal process rather than selecting among components evidence lists.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the bundle's components are explicitly enumerated in evidence; (2) only the aggregate result is reported; (3) the claim attributes the result to one enumerated component; (4) no evidence item reports component-level effects.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the measured value or state held continuously throughout the unmeasured interior interval.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports measurements at two or more discrete points of a continuum (dates, checkpoints, positions, load levels) and explicitly states that no measurement exists between them.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the claim extends beyond the outermost measured point (that is forbidden H1 territory for forward persistence, or see H2T091); if evidence reports continuous monitoring; or if the claim asserts an aggregate figure holds for a named sub-period of a single reported window (see H2T045).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T017 (finite observed performance extended into indefinite long-term persistence) and H1T029 (supported statement of an end date and absence of later follow-up). H1T017 extends outside the observation window into an unbounded future; H2T037 makes no claim outside the observed bounds and fills an explicitly declared interior gap. H1T029 preserves the gap/limit structure.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the measured points are explicit; (2) evidence explicitly states the interior gap is unmeasured; (3) the claim asserts continuity or persistence across that interior interval; (4) the claim stays within the outer measured bounds.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the same result or property for the other version.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a result, specification or property for an explicitly identified version, edition, release, revision or model year of an artefact, and states that a different version exists or superseded it.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the versions are identical in the relevant respect; if the result is reported for both versions; if the claim ignores an explicit retraction or withdrawal marker (see H2T058); or if the claim asserts the result for all versions universally (forbidden H1 territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (measurement scoped to one operating condition asserted across all conditions) and H1T002 (later entry adopted to resolve a conflict). H1T019 quantifies universally over conditions of use of a single artefact; H2T038 crosses an artefact-identity boundary to one specific other version. H1T002 requires two conflicting values for the same quantity; H2T038 requires exactly one reported value and no conflict.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the version identifier is explicit in the evidence sentence; (2) the existence of the other version is stated in evidence; (3) the claim binds the result to the other version; (4) no evidence item reports the result for that version.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the same performance, behaviour or result at a value outside the stated tested range.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports performance, behaviour or a result across an explicitly stated numeric operating range, scale, capacity or load band, and states no measurement outside that band.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the claim asserts a dose-response or causal relation across levels (see H2T027); if the claim asserts performance across all operating conditions universally (forbidden H1 territory); or if the extension is temporal rather than along the stated quantitative parameter.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (measurement scoped to one operating condition asserted across all operating conditions) and H1T017 (finite performance extended into indefinite persistence). H1T019 replaces a scope qualifier with a universal quantifier; H2T039 retains a bounded quantitative parameter and moves to a specific out-of-range point on it. H1T017 extends along time only.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the tested range or scale is explicitly bounded in evidence; (2) the claim names or implies a specific value outside that bound; (3) the asserted property is descriptive performance, not a causal law; (4) no evidence item reports behaviour outside the band.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that a figure computed on the closed set covers, includes or characterises the later-added members.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states that a cohort, register, sample or list was closed, frozen or cut off at a stated point, and states that further members, records or units were added or enrolled afterwards.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence reports an updated figure covering the additions; if the claim restates the figure with its closure qualifier (supported territory); or if the claim asserts the closed set is the complete relevant population (see H2T098).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T018 (subset presented as all sampled records) and H1T001 (subgroup result applied to the whole population). H1T018 misstates how many members of a fixed set met a criterion; H2T040 keeps the reported figure intact and extends the membership boundary across an explicitly stated closure event. H1T001 transfers between two concurrently defined populations rather than across a stated cut-off.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the closure point is explicit; (2) the existence of later additions is explicit; (3) the claim's scope includes the later additions; (4) no evidence item reports a figure covering them.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the individual results hold when the components operate in combination, or asserts a combined result obtained by composing them.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports results for components, modules, steps or interventions tested or measured individually, and states that they have not been evaluated together.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if combined evaluation is reported; if the claim credits one component for an aggregate bundle result (see H2T036); or if the claim sums non-disjoint counts (see H2T014).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (scoped measurement asserted across all operating conditions) and H1T007 (supported comparison of two conditions and their values). H1T019 widens a single measurement's scope; H2T041 composes several separately bounded measurements into a configuration that evidence states was never evaluated. H1T007 reports the separate values without composing them.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) individual-level results are explicit; (2) evidence states no combined evaluation exists; (3) the claim's subject is the combined configuration; (4) no evidence item reports interaction or combined performance.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the figures as final, complete, confirmed or closed.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack explicitly labels reported results as interim, preliminary, provisional, unaudited, in progress or subject to revision, and states that final results are not yet available.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if final results are reported; if the claim preserves the provisional status; if the claim asserts a planned or target value as realised (see H2T007); or if the claim asserts that an unresolved discrepancy has been settled (see H2T054).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T017 (finite observation extended into indefinite persistence) and H1T010 (supported confirmation that data are unavailable per an explicit note). H1T017 extends along time; H2T042 makes no temporal extension and upgrades the completion status of the same reporting period. H1T010 preserves the stated availability limitation; H2T042 deletes it.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the provisional label is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim omits it and asserts finality or completeness; (3) the numerals or content are otherwise unchanged; (4) no evidence item reports final results.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the result as characterising routine, production or real-world operation.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states that results were obtained under explicitly limited conditions - controlled, laboratory, pilot, sandbox, supervised, demonstration or restricted-deployment - and states that routine or full-scale operation differs or has not been evaluated.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if routine-operation results are reported; if the claim transports a causal effect to a named alternative setting (see H2T029); or if the claim extends beyond a tested numeric range (see H2T039).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T019 (measurement scoped to one operating condition asserted across all operating conditions) and H1T011 (availability conflated with effectiveness). H1T019 universally quantifies over conditions within the same operating mode; H2T043 crosses one explicitly declared boundary between an evaluation setting and routine operation and asserts nothing about all conditions. H1T011 asserts efficacy where nothing was measured.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the limited-setting label is explicit; (2) evidence states routine operation was not evaluated; (3) the claim's subject is routine or real-world operation; (4) the claim asserts a descriptive result rather than a transported causal effect.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the reported result applies to the excluded category.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states that a specified category, subgroup, site, record type or period was excluded, not covered, or out of scope for the reported analysis.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if a result for the excluded category is reported; if the claim asserts the result for all categories universally (forbidden H1 territory); if the excluded units are missing values inside a denominator (see H2T022); or if the claim asserts the covered set is exhaustive (see H2T087).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T001 (subgroup result applied to the entire population), H1T026 (conditional group result presented as the overall cohort result) and H1T019 (scope widened to all conditions). Each H1 entry widens to a superset or universal set; H2T044 targets a specific set that evidence explicitly removes from scope, and asserts nothing about the union of included and excluded groups.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the exclusion is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim's scope names or covers the excluded category; (3) the reported figure is otherwise unchanged; (4) no evidence item reports a result for the excluded category.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the aggregate figure as the value for a specific named sub-period or subset inside it.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a single aggregate figure covering a stated window or set and also states that conditions, volumes or performance varied within that window or set.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if disaggregated values are reported; if evidence states the value was constant; if the claim asserts continuity across an explicitly unmeasured gap between separate measurements (see H2T037); or if the claim extends outside the aggregate's boundary.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T001 (subgroup result applied to the entire population) and H1T026 (conditional group result presented as the overall cohort result). Both H1 entries move from a part to the whole; H2T045 moves from a stated whole to a part while evidence explicitly reports internal variation, and manufactures no population-level claim.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the aggregate's coverage is explicit; (2) evidence explicitly states internal variation; (3) the claim binds the aggregate numeral to a named interior sub-period or subset; (4) no evidence item reports the disaggregated value.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the standard, certification or acceptance set as a whole is satisfied.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack enumerates the criteria, requirements or checks comprising a defined standard, certification or acceptance set, reports that some were satisfied, and states that the remainder were not assessed.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if all criteria are reported as assessed; if the claim asserts that all records met one criterion (forbidden H1 territory); if the claim asserts conformity from adherence to a process (see H2T070); or if the claim asserts a credential the evidence never records (forbidden H1 territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T018 (subset of records presented as all sampled records) and H1T027 (peer-review status asserted despite a missing field). H1T018 generalises across records for a single criterion; H2T046 generalises across criteria for a single object, which is the orthogonal axis. H1T027 requires an absent status field; H2T046 requires an explicit partial-assessment statement.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the criteria set is enumerated in evidence; (2) evidence states which criteria were not assessed; (3) the claim asserts whole-set satisfaction or conformity; (4) no evidence item reports assessment of the remaining criteria.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the peak value as the routine, sustained or typical capability.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a best, peak, maximum or single-occasion observed value and reports no typical, average or sustained value for the same measure.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if a typical or sustained value is reported; if the claim relabels a named summary statistic without a typicality assertion (see H2T005); if the claim extends the value into a future period (forbidden H1 territory); or if the value is a planned target rather than an observation (see H2T007).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T017 (finite observed performance extended into indefinite persistence) and H1T024 (market-leading status inferred from a raw metric). H1T017 extends along time beyond the observed window; H2T047 stays inside the observed window and shifts the value's position in the observed distribution from extremum to central tendency. H1T024 adds a comparative market property.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the extremal status of the value is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim asserts typicality, sustainment or routine achievement; (3) the numeral is unchanged; (4) no evidence item reports a central or sustained value.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the measured value or result for the second entity on the strength of the stated similarity.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a measured value for one entity and separately states that a second named entity is similar, comparable, equivalent in design, or of the same class, without reporting any measurement for the second entity.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the second entity is measured; if the claim transports a causal effect (see H2T029); if the claim asserts the value for a class or all members universally (forbidden H1 territory); or if the similarity statement is absent from evidence.
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T001 (subgroup result applied to the entire population) and H1T019 (scoped measurement asserted across all conditions). Both H1 entries move from a measured set to a superset containing it; H2T048 moves laterally to a disjoint second entity and its inferential warrant is an explicit similarity statement rather than set inclusion.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the similarity statement is explicit in evidence; (2) no measurement exists for the second entity; (3) the claim binds the first entity's value to the second; (4) the claim asserts a descriptive value rather than a causal effect.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the midpoint, average or a blended figure of the two conflicting values as the value of the quantity.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports two figures for the same defined quantity, scope and period that differ beyond any stated rounding, and states no reconciliation, correction or precedence rule.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if the claim adopts one of the reported values (forbidden H1 territory); if the claim sums them as complementary parts (see H2T060); if the claim asserts the sources agree (see H2T050); or if the figures are defined differently (see H2T056).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T003 (arbitrary selection of one source's value) and H1T002 (later entry adopted as correct). Both H1 entries resolve the conflict by selecting a reported value; H2T049 asserts a value that appears in no evidence item and is produced by an arithmetic operation over the conflicting pair.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) both figures are explicitly for the same defined quantity and scope; (2) the discrepancy exceeds any stated rounding; (3) the claim states a single value arithmetically derived from both; (4) no evidence item authorises averaging.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts, at the meta level, that the sources agree, corroborate one another, or are consistent, without selecting or stating a value.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack contains two or more statements about the same defined quantity or finding that differ beyond stated rounding or explicitly disagree, and states no reconciliation.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the sources are consistent; if the claim adopts or derives a value (see H2T049 or forbidden H1 territory); or if the claim asserts the discrepancy does not matter for a conclusion (see H2T093).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T023 (supported identification of an unresolved numerical conflict) and H1T014 (dissent disregarded to assert a criterion was met). H1T023 asserts the conflict exists; H2T050 asserts its negation at the same meta level. H1T014 discards one input to reach a substantive criterion outcome; H2T050 reaches no substantive outcome and makes an evidentiary-agreement assertion only.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the disagreement is explicit or arithmetically evident from the stated figures; (2) the claim asserts concordance, corroboration or mutual confirmation; (3) the claim does not adopt or compute a value; (4) no evidence item states the sources are consistent.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts a specific reconciling explanation for the discrepancy - differing methodology, timing, rounding, definitions, data lag or an error source - that no evidence item states.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports conflicting figures or findings for the same defined quantity and offers no explanation of the discrepancy.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the explanation; if evidence itself shows the two figures use different stated definitions (see H2T056); if the claim asserts one figure is erroneous (see H2T052); or if the claim asserts the discrepancy is immaterial (see H2T093).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T003 (arbitrary selection of one source's value) and H1T005 (causal inference from a pre/post change). H1T003 selects a value and offers no account; H2T051 offers an unsupported account and selects no value. H1T005 asserts causation about the subject matter; H2T051 asserts causation about a measurement artefact and requires an explicit conflict, which H1T005 does not.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the conflict is explicit; (2) the claim names a cause of the discrepancy; (3) that cause is not stated by any evidence item; (4) the claim does not additionally declare which figure is correct.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that one of the conflicting figures is a mistake, typographical error, outlier or bad data, and treats the other as the value.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports conflicting figures for the same defined quantity and contains no statement that either figure is erroneous, corrected, provisional or an outlier.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence records a correction, erratum or data-quality flag (see H2T058); if the claim adopts one value without asserting the other is defective (forbidden H1 territory); or if the claim attributes the difference to a methodological cause rather than an error (see H2T051).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T003 (arbitrary selection of one source's value without reconciliation) and H1T002 (later entry adopted as correct). Both H1 entries select a value on no stated basis or on recency; H2T052's defining operation is the assertion of a new negative fact about the discarded figure's validity, which is content neither H1 entry contains.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the conflict is explicit; (2) the claim asserts a defect in one specific figure; (3) no evidence item records that defect; (4) the invalidation assertion is present in the claim, not merely implied by a choice.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the value reported by the numerical majority of sources as correct because more sources report it.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports the same defined quantity from three or more sources, with some sources agreeing and at least one differing, and states no voting, precedence or pooling rule.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if fewer than three sources are present; if evidence states a pooling rule; if the claim averages the values (see H2T049); or if the claim reports how many sources report each value without asserting correctness (supported territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T003 (arbitrary selection of one source's value) and H1T014 (dissenting classification disregarded to assert a criterion was met). H1T003 requires no counting warrant and exactly two competing values; H2T053 requires three or more and makes source frequency the explicit resolution rule. H1T014 concerns a single dissenting assessor within a decision procedure, not a frequency argument across independent value reports.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) three or more source values are reported; (2) the claim's warrant is the count of concurring sources; (3) evidence states no pooling or precedence rule; (4) the claim asserts correctness rather than merely reporting the distribution of values.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts that the matter has been resolved, corrected, reconciled or closed.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack states that a discrepancy, inconsistency, query or dispute is open, unresolved, under investigation, pending reconciliation or awaiting confirmation.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if resolution is reported; if the claim states a resolved value without asserting closure (forbidden H1 territory or see H2T049); or if the claim upgrades provisional results to final ones with no discrepancy involved (see H2T042).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T023 (supported identification of an unresolved numerical conflict) and H1T010 (supported confirmation that information is unavailable per an explicit note). Both H1 entries preserve an explicitly unsettled status; H2T054 asserts the status has changed, which neither H1 entry does.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the open status is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim asserts resolution or closure; (3) no evidence item reports the resolution; (4) the claim's subject is the same discrepancy.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts either the stated total or the reconstructed component sum as the figure, without disclosing the internal inconsistency.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports a stated total together with its itemised components, and the components do not sum to the stated total, with no evidence item acknowledging or explaining the difference.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence explains or reconciles the difference; if the conflict is between two independent sources rather than a total and its own components (assign another U5 template); or if the claim reports the mismatch itself (supported territory).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T003 (arbitrary selection of one source's value in an explicit conflict) and H1T028 (supported reporting of total intake and completion counts). H1T003 requires two independent competing sources; H2T055's conflict is internal to a single hierarchical statement and is detectable only by arithmetic. H1T028 restates totals whose components raise no inconsistency.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) both the total and the itemised components are explicit; (2) the arithmetic mismatch is determinable from the stated figures alone; (3) the claim asserts one of the two figures as the value; (4) no evidence item explains the difference (for example rounding, unallocated residual, excluded items).

claim_transformation: The claim treats the two figures as measuring the identical quantity: asserting one as the value of the other, or asserting a difference, gap or change between them.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports two figures bearing the same or similar label and explicitly states that they are constructed differently - different inclusion criteria, units, definitions, time bases or measurement standards.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence supplies a harmonisation; if the figures share a stated definition and simply conflict (assign another U5 template); or if the claim converts between measurement scales of a single figure (see H2T015).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T013 (conclusive superiority declared without equivalence adjustment) and H1T007 (supported comparison of two conditions and their metric values). H1T013 asserts a ranking between comparable arms lacking adjustment; H2T056 asserts identity or difference between quantities evidence explicitly defines differently, and need not assert superiority. H1T007 compares values the evidence defines consistently.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the definitional difference is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim equates or directly compares the two figures; (3) no evidence item supplies a harmonisation or conversion; (4) the claim does not disclose the definitional difference.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the decision as unconditional, final or effective without the stated conditions.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack records a decision, approval, certification or acceptance that is explicitly conditional, provisional, subject to stated conditions, or contingent on further steps.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if satisfaction of the conditions is reported; if the claim concerns a dissenting assessor's classification (forbidden H1 territory); if the claim asserts a criteria set is fully met from partial assessment (see H2T046); or if the claim upgrades interim results to final (see H2T042).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T014 (dissenting reviewer classification disregarded to assert a criterion was definitively met) and H1T027 (peer-review status asserted despite a missing field). H1T014 requires a recorded disagreement between assessors and discards one; H2T057 requires no disagreement at all and deletes stated conditions attached to a single unanimous decision. H1T027 requires an absent status field rather than a qualified positive one.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the conditions are explicit in the evidence sentence; (2) the claim asserts the decision outcome without them; (3) no evidence item reports the conditions being satisfied; (4) the decision subject and issuing body are otherwise unchanged.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts the content of the marked item as current, valid or established, ignoring the status marker.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack explicitly marks a source, record or result as withdrawn, retracted, superseded, corrected, expired or invalidated.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence reinstates the item; if two undifferentiated entries differ only by date (forbidden H1 territory); if the claim asserts one figure is erroneous without an evidence marker (see H2T052); or if the claim asserts a superseded version's result for the current version (see H2T038).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T002 (later entry adopted as correct to resolve an unadjudicated conflict) and H1T003 (arbitrary selection of one source's value). H1T002 and H1T003 operate where evidence supplies no status marker and the claim must choose between coequal entries; H2T058 operates where evidence supplies an explicit validity marker and the claim's defect is disregarding it.
inclusion_rule: Assign only if: (1) the invalidation marker is explicit in evidence; (2) the claim asserts the marked item's content as current fact; (3) the marker is absent from the claim; (4) no evidence item reinstates the item.

claim_transformation: The claim asserts a change, trend, increase or decrease between the two values.
evidence_condition: The EvidencePack reports two conflicting values for the same defined quantity that carry different timestamps, and states neither that the underlying quantity changed nor which figure is current.
exclusion_rule: Do not assign if evidence states the quantity changed or designates a current value; if the claim adopts the later value as correct (forbidden H1 territory); or if the claim compares two different groups measured once (see H2T068).
h1_non_equivalence: Closest H1: H1T002 (later entry adopted as the correct value) and H1T023 (supported identification of an unresolved conflict).
